sn30.17-46:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn30.17-46:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā jalābujānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ || pe ||
sn30.17-46:1.6: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī ||
sn30.17-46:1.8: Opapātikā supaṇṇā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn30.17-46:1.10: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || || 6
sn30.17-46:1.14: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn30.17-46:1.15: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
sn30.17-46:1.17: Evaṃ piṇḍakena cha cattālīsa suttantā honti || ||
